title: signcall clinic record
description: One clinic as returned by workflow/clinic_lookup.py. Four required fields -- what the agent needs to describe a clinic to the user and to call it -- plus an optional street address when the source actually has one. Sourced from Apify's Google Maps Scraper, or from the synthetic emergency fallback when a search yields nothing.

name.description: The listing's own name, e.g. 'Fremont Street Dental Care'.

type.description: The listing's own category, e.g. 'Dentist'. Falls back to the searched appointment-type label when Google Maps returns no category.

phone.description: US only, E.164. A listing without a callable US number is dropped rather than recorded.

zipcode.description: 5-digit US ZIP, ZIP+4 trimmed. Used to rank clinics by distance from the user.

address.description: The listing's own street address, when Maps returned one. Optional -- not part of the required four-field record, since the synthetic fallback has no real street to give.
